independent_computation.method: The scenario inputs are not in data/, so both golden values were treated as unknown-identity damage instances and solved against every sourced Syndra damage row. Requiring ONE ability power to explain both numbers pins the build uniquely.

step_1_solve_AP_from_the_new_value.hypothesis: 139.2 is Force of Will's Transcendent bonus TRUE damage (gated at 60 splinters -- matching the '_60' in the scenario id), rank 5.
step_1_solve_AP_from_the_new_value.note_on_the_wiki_precomputed_row: The wiki's own rounded row gives 22.8 + 0.116*600 + (0.0114*600)^2 = 139.1856. The exact composition (12% + 2% per 100 AP) x (190 + 65% AP) gives exactly 139.2; the 0.0144 gap is the wiki's rounding of the AP^2 coefficient (0.0114^2 = 0.00012996 vs the exact 0.02% x 65% = 0.00013). The new golden matches the exact composition, which is the correct one.
step_1_solve_AP_from_the_new_value.true_damage_is_unmitigated: 139.2 carries no 100/(100+MR) factor, as required -- true damage ignores resistances.

step_2_identify_the_old_value_at_the_sam.conclusion: 560.0 is Scatter the Weak (E) rank 5 at AP 600, delivered at full value -- which additionally forces the manual target's post-penetration magic resist to 0 (560 * 100/(100+MR) = 560 => MR = 0). The whole picture is self-consistent at a single AP.

step_3_rule_out_the_alternative.could_560_be_the_W_true_damage: No. Solving (0.12 + 0.0002*AP)*(190 + 0.65*AP) = 560 requires AP = 1635.0, which is impossible for the same fight that produces 139.2, and inconsistent with every other row.
step_3_rule_out_the_alternative.could_139_2_be_any_other_sourced_Syndra_: No. At AP 600 the complete sourced set is Q 650, W magic 580, W true 139.2, E 560, R/sphere 200 (r1) or 280 (r3), R min 600/1080, R max 1400/1960. 139.2 maps to the W true-damage instance and nothing else.
step_3_rule_out_the_alternative.could_139_2_be_560_mitigated: No. 139.2/560 = 0.248571 would require post-penetration MR = 302.3, contradicted by the E row landing at exactly 560.

step_4_why_the_index_moved.reading: Both 560.0 and 139.2 are legitimate sourced instances of the same fight; what changed at index 4 is which instance occupies the slot. Force of Will at >= 60 splinters is a MIXED-damage cast: a magic instance (580, mitigated by MR) plus a true instance (139.2, unmitigated). Emitting the true portion as its own damage event pushes every later event down one slot, so the E magic instance that used to sit at index 4 (560.0) moves to index 5 and the W true instance takes index 4.
step_4_why_the_index_moved.why_the_new_arrangement_is_the_correct_o: The true portion CANNOT share an event with the magic portion: the mitigation operator 100/(100+R) applies to the magic part and must not touch the true part (CLAUDE.md: 'True damage ignores all resistances entirely'). A merged 'Total Mixed Damage' event (580 + 139.2 = 719.2) would be mitigated as one packet and is wrong on any target with MR > 0; a missing true event would silently drop a sourced, wiki-documented 24%-of-W damage instance. Separating them is the only arrangement that mitigates each instance at its own rule, and it is what the reviewed module is audited to do ('60+ W true damage', batch-e9-1.json).
step_4_why_the_index_moved.residual_uncertainty: Because the scenario's cast order is not readable from data/, the exact set of instances preceding index 4 could not be enumerated. The verdict rests on the identity and magnitude of the value itself, both of which are exact and sourced, plus the mitigation argument above -- not on a reconstruction of the ordering.
